findings.title: NetworkPolicy allows a port name the pods do not declare
findings.cause: NetworkPolicy allow-web allows ingress on port "web", but the 1 pod it selects declare the named ports http (8080); a named port matches only the selected pods' own port names, so the rule allows nothing and that traffic is dropped

evidence.what: an ingress rule of allow-web allows port web
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy allow-web -n kd-netpol-port-name-unknown -o jsonpath='{.spec.ingress}'

evidence.what: the selected pods declare the named ports http (8080)
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-5cf8965884-8dd2g -n kd-netpol-port-name-unknown -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

findings.fix: Name the port in the rule as the pods do, or use the port number; or add name: web to the containers' port that should be reachable.
